Write the site note using exactly this template:

Curve type: <VES curve type>

Station: T-04
Curve type: Q-type (resistivity decreases monotonically with depth — 4201.4 → 2238.9 → 343.9 → 25.0 → 10.9 Ω·m). Note: this contradicts the "H-type" label on file; the interpretation should be re-checked, as it affects aquifer targeting.
Aquifer depth: ~41.3–42.3 m (thin low-resistivity Layer 4, 25.0 Ω·m), continuing into the very low-resistivity basal layer (10.9 Ω·m) below 42.3 m.

Recommendation: Target drilling to at least 42–45 m to confirm and penetrate the low-resistivity zone beginning at ~41.3 m, which likely represents a saturated/clay-rich aquifer horizon; recommend re-verifying the curve classification before finalizing casing and screen placement, as the Q-type signature (all layers decreasing in resistivity) differs from the filed H-type designation and may indicate the resistive Layer 3 is unsaturated rather than a confining unit.
